cleaned_flux.observable: P5 stellar.fits contains cleaned old-stellar flux, MJy/sr
cleaned_flux.conditional_mass_conversion: Sigma_star_projected = Upsilon36 Sigma_L_projected; face-on disk Sigma = projected Sigma cos(i)
cleaned_flux.limitations: Not independent mass. Absolute calibration, ICA residuals and population assumptions remain. Catalog quality and bootstrap colors do not replace a pixel covariance model.

cleaned_color.input: Vega color of old stellar light after removal of nonstellar emission
cleaned_color.applicability_note: Stellar-population/IMF-dependent. No per-pixel masses or replacement old runs computed.

global_uncleaned_color.input: Original integrated 3.6/4.5 micron fluxes in matched apertures, including nonstellar emission

sings_calibration.weight_semantics: ten times the number of contributing frames, not inverse variance
sings_calibration.calibration_basis: 12 arcsec radius stellar aperture; extended-source and aperture photometry require additional calibration
sings_calibration.background: A constant was subtracted; spatial background structure can remain, with NGC6946 explicitly mentioned in the guide

molecular_gas.source_unit: CO(2-1) Tmb integrated intensity in K km/s
molecular_gas.moment_error_semantics: emom0 is expected one-sigma RMS over the same integration window; not a complete spatial covariance
molecular_gas.selection: Release moment-0 integrates the union of a local-HI-window mask and a bright-emission mask; finite values can be nondetections
molecular_gas.formula: Sigma_molecular_including_He_projected = alpha_CO10_including_He * I21 / R21; R21 = I21/I10
molecular_gas.face_on_formula: Sigma_faceon = Sigma_projected cos(i), conditional flat-disk geometry
molecular_gas.retained_primary_equation_inconsistency: The recovered 2009 HTML equations 3-4 display R21/0.8, although R21 is defined as I21/I10. This ratio direction contradicts direct substitution; use of that printed general scaling is unsupported. The independent 2008 A2-A3 normalization and column-density algebra are the implemented controls. No claim about author intent or an erratum is made.
molecular_gas.reference_2022_scope: Mean across mapping measurements; high-mass nearby star-forming galaxies dominate. Not a universal or per-pixel seed measurement; repeats and population scatter matter.
molecular_gas.calibration_epoch_limit: The 2022 paper notes earlier HERACLES R21=0.8 was revised downward with updated beam efficiency. The 2011 cached maps contain applied-efficiency history; no cross-release recalibration was validated here. Do not infer that the 21.68 percent coefficient difference is a measured gas-mass correction.
unresolved: ionized/hot gas and other missing baryons

historical_findings.finding: Citation says McGaugh & Schombert for arXiv:1402.5210; actual paper is Meidt et al. 2014.

The cleaned-P5 COLOR_PUBLISHED_WITH_FALLBACK branch declares the global-uncleaned Querejeta formula with a different color window (-0.15,-0.02). Its applicability is not supported by that calibration. Actual historical per-pixel impact was not recomputed.
historical_findings.disposition: UNSUPPORTED_CONVERSION_CONTEXT; preserve frozen branch pending integration review

current_atlas_common_basis_and_mixed_fie.scope: Read-only provenance trace, no new source fit or field/motion computation
